items.html: And when the upper Emanator began to create the world, He emanated and created and formed and made the four worlds ABYA, and He began to sort the aforementioned kings who had died. That which was sorted out of him rose into the holiness of the worlds, and that which was not sorted remained shell and dross. Indeed, the root of all this dross and of these kings is one name BON, and it is a single Partzuf of Adam from its head to its feet, and there are shells opposite it from its head to its feet.
